items.statement: Independent structure and energy exploration supports two interaction-strength regimes relative to AI2.
items.expected: AI-[OTf]-, AI-[BF4]- and AI-Br- are close to AI2, whereas AI-[NF2]-, AI-[NTf2]-, AI-[NNf2]- and AI-[DCA]- are less negative, with the claim tied to submitted calculations.

items.statement: The investigation cannot by itself convert isolated electronic interaction energies into ionic-liquid dimerization thermodynamics.
items.expected: The report limits its interpretation to isolated clusters and discusses conformer/method coverage.
